facts.fact: As of 28 Oct 2026 the latest All-India CPI-IW (base 2016=100) is for August 2026: 154.4 points, up 1.2 points from July
facts.quote: The All-India CPI-IW for August, 2026 increased by 1.2 points and stood at 154.4 points

facts.fact: The Labour Bureau released the August 2026 CPI-IW on 30 September 2026
facts.quote: Dated: 30.09.2026 Press Release Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers (2016=100) – August, 2026

behaviour: Gives the latest month and All-India CPI-IW index value with its release date from labourbureau.gov.in; if a newer month has been released by the time of testing, that one is expected instead.
fail_if: It gives an older month as the latest without its date, invents a figure, or cites an unofficial site.
summary: Labour Bureau press release dated 30.09.2026: All-India CPI-IW for August 2026 = 154.4 (base 2016=100); the September index was not yet out on 28 Oct 2026.
